text.text_excerpt: So excited to have a great coffee shop back in this location! I stopped in today after hearing from a neighbor that Undergrowth Coffee had taken over the space after Hey! Cafe left. Walking in I loved what Undergrowth did to the place. The green paint gives it an airy and welcoming vibe that it didn't have previously. I grabbed an iced latte and hubby grabbed a regular drip coffee. Loved my iced latte. It was smooth and delicious. Hubby enjoyed his plain drip too. Happened to notice that they have some delicious sounding seasonal flavors on their outdoor menu board. Wish I'd noticed them before ordering my standard iced latte but gives me an excuse to have to go back! :) Another great thi...

Such a great coffee spot right on the corner of Magazine and Napoleon. The pastries were DELICIOUS (some of them I know are sourced from Compagnon Bakery)- the scone is not dry like others and the croissant is sooo flaky and crispy. I also love that they give you the option to warm up your pastries- not all coffee shops do. Nice selection of coffee and teas to choose from, plus other snacks like oatmeal, hummus, and yogurt bowls. Super cute space with lots of greenery, though I wish they had some more indoor seating. So happy to have a new coffee spot in this location, and after one visit to Undergrowth, I think they're the perfect people to fill the gap that Hey! left when they moved to Tipitina's. The owner said they'll be selling their own beans soon and I can't wait to buy some, they have great plain iced coffee and another fun one brewed with cinnamon and cacao.
